description: Detect It Easy - file type, compiler, packer, protector, and binary analysis tool
pre_install: $exe = Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Recurse -Filter 'die.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { throw 'die.exe was not found in the extracted archive.' }; if ($exe.DirectoryName -ne $dir) { Get-ChildItem -Path $exe.DirectoryName -Force | Move-Item -Destination $dir -Force }
